claim: Influenza is responsible for an estimated 250,000–500,000 deaths each year worldwide.
source_text: Influenza remains one of the major threats to human health worldwide and is responsible for an estimated 250,000–500,000 deaths each year
evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by a citation to the World Health Organization, 2009.

claim: The influenza virus was first isolated from humans in 1933.
source_text: Attempts at immunization pre-dated the isolation of the virus from humans in 1933
evidence_reasoning: This historical fact is supported by citation to Smith et al., 1933.

claim: Since 1977, strains of influenza A (H3N2), influenza A (H1N1), and influenza B have been responsible for the majority of documented human infections.
source_text: Since 1977, strains of influenza A (H3N2), influenza A (H1N1), and influenza B have been responsible for the majority of documented human infections
evidence_reasoning: This is presented as established scientific knowledge about influenza epidemiology.

claim: Animal models have demonstrated that immune responses and susceptibility to influenza infection can be strongly influenced by host genetic factors.
source_text: Animal models have demonstrated that immune responses and susceptibility to influenza infection can be strongly influenced by host genetic factors
evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by citations to Trammell and Toth, 2008 and Srivastava et al., 2009.

claim: Variability in the immune response to vaccination is likely to be influenced by genotype.
source_text: As with viral infection, variability in the immune response to vaccination is likely to be influenced by genotype.
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the animal model data on genetic influences on infection susceptibility.

claim: Twin and sibling studies have shown heritability estimates as high as 45% for a varicella vaccine.
source_text: twin and sibling studies have shown heritability estimates as high as 45% for a varicella vaccine
evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by citation to Klein et al., 2007.

claim: Twin and sibling studies have shown heritability estimates as high as 90% for a measles vaccine.
source_text: twin and sibling studies have shown heritability estimates as high as 45% for a varicella vaccine (Klein et al., 2007) and 90% for a measles vaccine
evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by citation to Tan et al., 2001.

claim: Studies investigating influenza vaccine immunogenicity in humans have consistently shown large inter-individual variability.
source_text: Studies investigating influenza vaccine immunogenicity in humans have consistently shown large inter-individual variability
evidence_reasoning: This is presented as established knowledge from prior research.

claim: The genetic contribution to variability in influenza vaccine immunogenicity remains poorly understood.
source_text: the genetic contribution to this variability remains poorly understood
evidence_reasoning: This characterizes the state of knowledge in the field prior to this study.

claim: Gene expression is strongly controlled by common genetic variants.
source_text: Gene expression is strongly controlled by common genetic variants
evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by citations to Morley et al., 2004 and Stranger et al., 2007.

claim: Common genetic variants that control gene expression have both broad and tissue-specific effects.
source_text: Gene expression is strongly controlled by common genetic variants (Morley et al., 2004; Stranger et al., 2007) with both broad (Bullaughey et al., 2009) and tissue-specific effects
evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by citations to Bullaughey et al., 2009, Innocenti et al., 2011, and Rotival et al., 2011.

claim: Genetic variants that control gene expression are referred to as expression quantitative trait loci (eQTL).
source_text: with both broad (Bullaughey et al., 2009) and tissue-specific effects (Innocenti et al., 2011; Rotival et al., 2011), referred to as expression quantitative trait loci (eQTL)
evidence_reasoning: This is a standard definition in the field of genomics.

claim: Genome-wide association studies have identified hundreds of variants associated with human disease risk that are also eQTL.
source_text: genome-wide association studies have identified hundreds of variants associated with human disease risk that are also eQTL
evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by multiple citations including Emilsson et al., 2008, Cookson et al., 2009, and others.

claim: Disease-associated variants that are also eQTL influence disease risk through variation in transcriptional responses.
source_text: implying that the mechanism by which they influence risk involves variation in transcriptional responses
evidence_reasoning: This is an inference drawn from GWAS studies, supported by the cited literature.

claim: Integrative genomic studies in model organisms have demonstrated that the combination of genetic and transcriptional information can allow direct tests of causal mechanisms in controlled experiments.
source_text: integrative genomic studies in model organisms (Schadt et al., 2005; Amit et al., 2009) have demonstrated that the combination of genetic and transcriptional information can allow direct tests of causal mechanisms in controlled experiments
evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by citations to Schadt et al., 2005 and Amit et al., 2009.

claim: The study immunized an ethnically homogeneous group of 119 healthy adult male volunteers with licensed trivalent influenza vaccine.
source_text: We immunized an ethnically homogeneous group of 119 healthy adult male volunteers with licensed trivalent influenza vaccine.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the experimental design and sample size of the discovery cohort.

claim: DNA was obtained from peripheral blood and genome-wide SNP genotyping was performed in the study.
source_text: DNA was obtained from peripheral blood and genome-wide SNP genotyping was performed.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the data collection methods used in the study.

claim: Global transcript abundance was measured in peripheral blood RNA specimens before and at three time points (days 1, 3, and 14) after vaccination.
source_text: We also measured global transcript abundance in peripheral blood RNA specimens before and at three time points (days 1, 3, and 14) after vaccination.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the longitudinal gene expression measurement design.

claim: Type-specific antibody measurements (H1N1, H3N2, and FluB) were made in serum samples before and at two time points (days 14 and 28) after vaccination.
source_text: Type-specific antibody measurements (H1N1, H3N2, and FluB) were made in serum samples before and at two time points (days 14 and 28) after vaccination.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the antibody measurement protocol.

claim: An identical study was carried out with an independent validation cohort of 128 ethnically homogeneous healthy adult female volunteers.
source_text: An identical study was then carried out with an independent validation cohort of 128 ethnically homogeneous healthy adult female volunteers.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the validation cohort design and sample size.

claim: The study identified 20 genes exhibiting a transcriptional response to vaccination, significant genotype effects on gene expression, and correlation between the transcriptional and antibody responses.
source_text: We identified 20 genes exhibiting a transcriptional response to vaccination, significant genotype effects on gene expression, and correlation between the transcriptional and antibody responses.
evidence_reasoning: This is a primary finding from the integrative analysis of the study data.

claim: Variation at the level of genes involved in membrane trafficking and antigen processing significantly influences the human response to influenza vaccination.
source_text: The results show that variation at the level of genes involved in membrane trafficking and antigen processing significantly influences the human response to influenza vaccination.
evidence_reasoning: This is a conclusion drawn from the pathway enrichment analysis of the identified genes.

claim: An integrative study design is an efficient alternative to existing methods for the identification of genes involved in complex traits.
source_text: we demonstrate that an integrative study design is an efficient alternative to existing methods for the identification of genes involved in complex traits
evidence_reasoning: This is a methodological conclusion drawn from the success of the study approach.

claim: 78 genes showed evidence of significant genotype-expression association and evidence of a transcriptional response to the vaccine in both cohorts.
source_text: The 78 genes that showed both properties in the two cohorts are shown in the outer margin.
evidence_reasoning: This is a quantitative result from the analysis shown in Figure 1.

claim: At some loci, the magnitude of the genetic effect on gene expression is different before and at different time points after vaccination.
source_text: We hypothesized that, at some loci, the magnitude of the genetic effect could be different before and at different time points after vaccination.
evidence_reasoning: This hypothesis was tested and confirmed with the serial expression data.

claim: The genetic effect that varies with time after vaccination would not be observed in a cross-sectional study design.
source_text: This type of effect, which would not be observed in a cross-sectional study design, could be directly examined with our serial expression data.
evidence_reasoning: This is a logical inference about the limitations of cross-sectional designs.

claim: An increase in the strength of the genotype effect (slope of the additive association) was the main driver for the observed change in R²g after vaccination.
source_text: Figure 2B shows that an increase in the strength of the genotype effect (slope of the additive association) was the main driver for the observed change in Rg2
evidence_reasoning: This is a finding from the analysis of variance components shown in Figure 2B.

claim: The increase in amplitude of the genotype effect was a general feature of the loci showing both a strong cis-acting eQTL and a transcriptional response to the vaccine stimulus.
source_text: this amplitude change was a general feature of the loci in which we observed both a strong cis-acting eQTL and a transcriptional response to the vaccine stimulus
evidence_reasoning: This is a generalization from the analysis of multiple loci.

claim: The delta-R²g values were consistent between the cohorts when evaluated by Spearman's rank correlation analysis (Cor = 0.25, p<2 × 10⁻¹⁶).
source_text: The delta-Rg2 values were consistent between the cohorts when evaluated by Spearman's rank correlation analysis using all SNP-transcript pairs (Cor = 0.25, p<2 × 10−16).
evidence_reasoning: This is a statistical result from correlation analysis between cohorts.

claim: 146 SNP-transcript pairs were identified that were in the top 1% of the delta-R²g distribution and showed evidence of a strong cis-acting eQTL in both cohorts.
source_text: Data for the resulting set of 146 SNP-transcript pairs, including Rg2 values, are provided in Table 2
evidence_reasoning: This is a quantitative result from applying specific selection criteria.

claim: The 98 genes with strongest evidence of genotype effect and transcriptional response showed significant enrichment for genes involved in antigen processing and presentation.
source_text: Content analysis on the union of the two sets (98 genes) showed significant enrichment for genes involved in antigen processing and presentation
evidence_reasoning: This is a result from pathway enrichment analysis shown in Figure 3.

claim: The 98 genes showed significant enrichment for genes involved in cytotoxic T-lymphocyte-mediated apoptosis of target cells.
source_text: Content analysis on the union of the two sets (98 genes) showed significant enrichment for genes involved in antigen processing and presentation, cytotoxic T-lymphocyte-mediated apoptosis of target cells
evidence_reasoning: This is a result from pathway enrichment analysis.

claim: The 98 genes showed significant enrichment for genes involved in dendritic cell maturation and function.
source_text: Content analysis on the union of the two sets (98 genes) showed significant enrichment for genes involved in antigen processing and presentation, cytotoxic T-lymphocyte-mediated apoptosis of target cells, dendritic cell maturation and function
evidence_reasoning: This is a result from pathway enrichment analysis.

claim: The 98 genes showed significant enrichment for genes involved in membrane trafficking.
source_text: Content analysis on the union of the two sets (98 genes) showed significant enrichment for genes involved in antigen processing and presentation, cytotoxic T-lymphocyte-mediated apoptosis of target cells, dendritic cell maturation and function, and membrane trafficking
evidence_reasoning: This is a result from pathway enrichment analysis.

claim: For some transcripts there is significant correlation between the magnitude of the transcriptional and antibody responses to the vaccine stimulus.
source_text: We and others have shown that for some transcripts there is significant correlation between the magnitude of the transcriptional and antibody responses to the vaccine stimulus
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by data from this study and prior published work.

claim: 301 genes showed evidence of significant correlation between gene expression and the antibody response to the vaccine in both cohorts.
source_text: A total of 301 genes showed evidence of significant correlation between gene expression and the antibody response to the vaccine in both cohorts.
evidence_reasoning: This is a quantitative result from correlation analysis shown in Figure 4B.

claim: Of the 301 genes showing correlation with antibody response, 281 showed evidence of positive correlation.
source_text: Of these, 281 showed evidence of positive correlation
evidence_reasoning: This is a quantitative breakdown of the correlation results.

claim: Of the 301 genes showing correlation with antibody response, 83 showed evidence of negative correlation.
source_text: Of these, 281 showed evidence of positive correlation and 83 of negative correlation.
evidence_reasoning: This is a quantitative breakdown of the correlation results.

claim: Seven of the 20 genes showing evidence of transcriptional response, genotype effects, and correlation with antibody response are involved in intracellular antigen transport, antigen processing, and antigen presentation.
source_text: Remarkably, seven of these are involved in intracellular antigen transport, antigen processing, and antigen presentation.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on functional annotation of the identified genes.

claim: 137 eQTL SNPs from the 20 identified loci were used to determine genetic associations to the antibody response.
source_text: We determined genetic associations to the antibody response using 137 eQTL SNPs from these 20 loci.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the QTL analysis approach.

claim: The quantile-quantile plot from association tests on the 137 SNPs shows marked deviation from the empirical null distribution for QTL associations.
source_text: The quantile-quantile plot from the association tests performed on these SNPs shows marked deviation from the empirical null distribution for QTL associations
evidence_reasoning: This is a result from the QTL analysis shown in Figure 6.

claim: The deviation from the null distribution in the QTL analysis suggests that the identified SNPs are enriched for true associations with the antibody response.
source_text: The quantile-quantile plot from the association tests performed on these SNPs shows marked deviation from the empirical null distribution for QTL associations
evidence_reasoning: This is the standard interpretation of QQ plot deviation in genetic association studies.

claim: Three types of associations were explored: genotype to gene expression (eQTL), gene expression to antibody titer, and genotype to antibody titer (QTL).
source_text: We explored three types of associations in our work: genotype to gene expression (eQTL), gene expression to antibody titer, and genotype to antibody titer (QTL).
evidence_reasoning: This describes the analytical framework used in the study.

claim: Three models were evaluated for the relationships between genotype, expression, and trait: independent, causal, and reactive.
source_text: Three models were evaluated, each showing a candidate hypothesis for the three-way association between genotype (G), expression (E) and trait (T).
evidence_reasoning: This describes the causal modeling approach shown in Figure 7.

claim: In the independent model, expression and trait each associate with genotype but are not themselves directly related.
source_text: In the independent model, expression and trait each associate with genotype but are not themselves directly related.
evidence_reasoning: This defines one of the tested models.

claim: In the causal model, expression mediates the association between genotype and trait.
source_text: In the causal model, expression mediates the association between genotype and trait.
evidence_reasoning: This defines one of the tested models.

claim: In the reactive model, genotype and expression relate through the trait, so that gene expression changes are a downstream response to the trait.
source_text: In the reactive model, genotype and expression relate through the trait, so that gene expression changes are a downstream response to the trait.
evidence_reasoning: This defines one of the tested models.

claim: Variation at the level of genes involved in antigen processing and intracellular trafficking is an important determinant of vaccine immunogenicity.
source_text: They suggest that variation at the level of genes involved in antigen processing and intracellular trafficking is an important determinant of vaccine immunogenicity.
evidence_reasoning: This is a conclusion drawn from the pathway enrichment and correlation analyses.

claim: In healthy, young individuals, there are a significant number of people who do not develop a protective antibody response after influenza vaccination.
source_text: Even in healthy, young individuals, there are a significant number of people who do not develop a protective antibody response after influenza vaccination.
evidence_reasoning: This is presented as established knowledge about vaccine response variability.

claim: If individuals who do not develop protective antibody responses could be identified prior to vaccination, modifications to the type or dose of vaccine could be attempted.
source_text: If these individuals could be identified prior to vaccination, modifications to the type or dose of vaccine could be attempted, with the goal of reducing the number of unprotected vaccinated individuals.
evidence_reasoning: This is a hypothetical application of the research findings.

claim: The genes identified in this study as playing a role in variation in the humoral response to vaccination would be a logical starting point for the development of DNA- or RNA-based predictive biomarkers.
source_text: The genes identified in this study as playing a role in variation in the humoral response to vaccination would be a logical starting point for the development of DNA- or RNA-based predictive biomarkers.
evidence_reasoning: This is a proposed future application of the findings.

claim: Prospective evaluation of biomarkers based on the identified genes would be the next step towards clinical implementation.
source_text: Prospective evaluation of such biomarkers would be the next step towards clinical implementation.
evidence_reasoning: This proposes a future research direction.

claim: Understanding the mechanisms that underlie variation in response to the vaccine may direct modification of factors that enhance the response.
source_text: Understanding the mechanisms that underlie variation in response to the vaccine may also direct modification of factors that enhance the response.
evidence_reasoning: This is a hypothetical application of mechanistic understanding.

claim: Most efforts to enhance vaccine response to date have focused on vaccine adjuvants that activate known immunologic mechanisms.
source_text: Most of the efforts to date have focused on vaccine adjuvants that activate known immunologic mechanisms.
evidence_reasoning: This characterizes the current state of vaccine development approaches.

claim: Many of the genes identified in this study encode proteins that are not specifically immune but play a more general role in membrane trafficking and intracellular transport.
source_text: Surprisingly, many of the genes identified in this study encode proteins that are not specifically immune but play a more general role in membrane trafficking and intracellular transport.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on functional annotation of the identified genes.

claim: Interventions aimed at increasing vaccine antigen affinity to membrane trafficking proteins or altering their intracellular concentrations could represent new avenues in vaccine development.
source_text: Interventions aimed at increasing vaccine antigen affinity to these proteins or altering their intracellular concentrations could represent new avenues in vaccine development.
evidence_reasoning: This is a hypothetical application of the findings to vaccine development.

claim: A longitudinal, integrative genomic analysis study design, applied to a clinical intervention, is an efficient alternative to cross-sectional methods for the identification of genes involved in medically relevant complex traits.
source_text: the results demonstrate that a longitudinal, integrative genomic analysis study design, applied to a clinical intervention, is an efficient alternative to cross-sectional methods for the identification of genes involved in medically relevant complex traits
evidence_reasoning: This is a methodological conclusion drawn from the study's success.

claim: By making repeated measurements on the same individual over time after a controlled experimental perturbation, the study was able to account for individual variation in a way that would not have been possible otherwise.
source_text: By making repeated measurements on the same individual over time after a controlled experimental perturbation, we were able to account for individual variation in a way that would not have been possible otherwise.
evidence_reasoning: This is a logical inference about the advantages of the longitudinal design.

claim: The dynamic nature of the measurements allowed the study to uncover genetic effects that are either enhanced by or only evident after the experimental perturbation.
source_text: The dynamic nature of the measurements also allowed us to uncover genetic effects that are either enhanced by or only evident after the experimental perturbation.
evidence_reasoning: This is demonstrated by the delta-R²g analysis results.

claim: The specificity of gene identification in this study emerges from the genome's acute response to the perturbation, which cannot be assessed by a cross-sectional eQTL analysis or a genome-wide association study.
source_text: The specificity of gene identification in this study emerges from the genome's acute response to the perturbation, which cannot be assessed by a cross-sectional eQTL analysis or a genome-wide association study.
evidence_reasoning: This is a logical inference about the advantages of the perturbation-based design.

claim: The integrative genomic approach could be used for a broad variety of medically important problems whenever there is the opportunity to test a well-controlled intervention such as drug, dietary, or vaccine responses.
source_text: This approach could be used for a broad variety of medically important problems whenever there is the opportunity to test a well-controlled intervention such as drug, dietary, or vaccine responses.

claim: The study excluded the segments of the population that are most likely to have a poor response to influenza vaccination: children, the elderly, and individuals with severe illnesses.
source_text: First, we studied two samples of healthy young adults, thereby excluding the segments of the population that are most likely to have a poor response to influenza vaccination: children, the elderly, and individuals with severe illnesses.

claim: To minimize the risk of false associations related to population stratification, the study examined an ethnically homogeneous group of individuals.
source_text: in order to minimize the risk of false associations related to population stratification, we studied an ethnically homogeneous group of individuals
evidence_reasoning: This describes a design choice to control for confounding.

claim: The sample size in this study was not sufficient to establish whether or not there is a causal relationship between the identified loci and the antibody response to the vaccine.
source_text: the sample size in this study was not sufficient to establish whether or not there is a causal relationship between the loci for which an association was identified and the antibody response to the vaccine

claim: Antibody titers do not capture the complexity of the human immune response to vaccination.
source_text: while antibody titers have historically been used to evaluate vaccine responsiveness, it is clear that they do not capture the complexity of the human immune response to vaccination
evidence_reasoning: This is presented as established knowledge about the limitations of antibody measurements.

claim: Additional studies would be necessary to determine whether the identified genes are related to variation in influenza vaccine responses in groups other than healthy young adults.
source_text: Additional studies would be necessary to determine whether the genes identified are also related to variation in influenza vaccine responses in groups other than the one chosen for this study

claim: Study participants were healthy volunteers ages 18 to 40 years.

source_text: To minimize false-positive results related to population stratification, enrollment was limited to individuals of self-reported Caucasian ancestry.

claim: The initial (discovery) cohort was restricted to males.
source_text: The initial (discovery) cohort was restricted to males.

claim: The validation cohort was enrolled approximately 18 months after the initial cohort and was restricted to females.
source_text: The validation cohort was enrolled approximately 18 months after the initial cohort and was restricted to females.

source_text: Those enrolled in the initial cohort received the 2008–2009 inactivated trivalent influenza vaccine (A/Brisbane/59/2007[H1N1], A/Brisbane/10/2007[H3N2], B/Florida/4/2006; Sanofi-Pasteur, Lyon, France).

claim: Genotyping was performed on Illumina HumanOmniExpress microarrays which include 730,525 SNP markers.
source_text: Genotyping was performed on Illumina HumanOmniExpress microarrays (Illumina, Inc., San Diego, CA) following the manufacturer's instructions. The arrays include 730,525 SNP markers.

claim: All genotyping microarrays had call rates >0.99.
source_text: All microarrays had call rates >0.99.

claim: cRNA was hybridized onto Illumina HumanHT-12v3 or HumanHT-12v4 Expression BeadChips.
source_text: cRNA was hybridized onto Illumina HumanHT-12v3 or HumanHT-12v4 Expression BeadChips (Illumina, Inc.), following the manufacturer's protocol.

source_text: The arrays have 48,742 (v3) and 47,301 (v4) reporters, representing approximately 25,000 genes and non-annotated gene candidates.

claim: The HumanHT-12v4 arrays have 47,301 reporters representing approximately 25,000 genes and non-annotated gene candidates.
source_text: The arrays have 48,742 (v3) and 47,301 (v4) reporters, representing approximately 25,000 genes and non-annotated gene candidates.

source_text: Hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) tests were performed as previously described (Dowdle et al., 1979), except for a starting serum dilution of 1:4 and the use of turkey red blood cells.

claim: The change in antibody titer post-vaccination is negatively correlated with the pre-vaccination titer for all antigens.
source_text: For all antigens, the change in antibody titer post-vaccination is known to be negatively correlated with the pre-vaccination titer.

claim: The responses to the individual viral antigens were correlated within individuals.
source_text: The responses to the individual viral antigens were correlated within individuals.

claim: The Titer Response Index (TRI) characterizes the magnitude of an individual's antibody rise accounting for their pre-vaccination titer and integrating the responses across the three vaccine components.
source_text: The TRI characterizes the magnitude of an individual's antibody rise accounting for their pre-vaccination titer and integrating the responses across the three vaccine components to provide an overall measure of vaccine responsiveness.

source_text: Eight individuals had missing expression data from two or more time points and were excluded.

source_text: and excluded any reporters that did not map or mapped to more than one region

claim: The final data set for the discovery cohort included 9809 detected transcripts.
source_text: Using these two thresholds for the data in the discovery cohort, the final data set included 9809 detected transcripts.

claim: Five individuals in the validation cohort had missing expression data from two or more time points and were excluded.
source_text: Five individuals had missing expression data from two or more time points and were excluded.

source_text: 12 outliers were identified in each cohort and were removed prior to analysis.

claim: The study samples cluster with the HapMap CEU population in multidimensional scaling analysis.
source_text: As expected, the study samples cluster with the HapMap CEU population.

claim: A random effects linear model was used to analyze repeated gene expression measurements on the same individuals over time.
source_text: Because we have repeated gene expression measurements on the same individuals over a series of time points, we performed a random effects linear model analysis.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the statistical modeling approach.

claim: The random effects model included terms for day, additive effects for genotype and day–genotype interactions, and a random effect for each person.
source_text: For each SNP-transcript pair, we fit a model with terms for day, additive effects for genotype and day–genotype interactions, and a random effect for each person
evidence_reasoning: This describes the structure of the statistical model.

claim: The proportion of expression variance explained by individual genotypes was estimated from the model's coefficient of determination (R²g).
source_text: This allowed estimates of the proportion of expression variance explained by individual genotypes from the model's coefficient of determination (R2g).
evidence_reasoning: This describes how genetic effect size was quantified.

claim: To detect SNP-transcript pairs where the magnitude of the genotype effect varied after immunization, the difference in R²g measures (ΔR²g) was calculated from pairwise linear models fitted after and before vaccination.
source_text: To detect SNP-transcript pairs where the magnitude of the genotype effect varied after immunization, we took the difference in R2g measures (ΔR2g) from pairwise linear models fitted after (days 1, 3 and 14) and before vaccination (day 0).
evidence_reasoning: This describes the method for identifying dynamic genetic effects.

claim: The top 1% ΔR²g values between day 0 and a later time point were selected to represent loci showing significant changes in the genetic effect as a result of the vaccine.
source_text: We then took the top 1% ΔR2g values between day 0 and a later time point. This cis-acting eQTL subset represents the loci that show significant changes in the genetic effect as a result of the vaccine.
